lastCompletedStory.title: Make the plan-phase failure records honest: reason-bearing planner terminal, distinguishable auditor results, uncorrupted phase field

nextStoryContext: US-004 (CAM-479) fixed the plan phase's three record-integrity defects in src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts, symmetric with US-001..US-003's implementer/reviewer fixes but for the plan phase. (1) pollPlannerDeath no longer returns a bare boolean: it returns a PlannerPollOutcome ('completed' | 'pane-died' | 'timeout'). 'pane-died' fires only when readPlannerReportFn IS defined and the pane died before it ever returned non-null; when readPlannerReportFn is undefined (backward-compat), pane death still resolves to 'completed' so the pre-existing no-detector callers are unaffected. The caller now returns { kind: 'planner-failed', reason: 'planner pane exited before writing prd.json' } instead of the old two-step (poll returns true on pane death -> isPlannerNoPrd() second read discards the cause) -- isPlannerNoPrd was deleted, its logic folded directly into the poll's own return. (2) pollAuditorReport's failure branch changed from bare { ok: false } to { ok: false; cause: 'pane-died' | 'cap-elapsed' } (PlanTimeoutCause, shared with the planner reason-builder). The PlanPhaseResult kind for the caller stays 'auditor-timeout' either way (no consumer needed a new kind), but emitPlanTimeoutTerminal now takes an optional cause param and threads it into planTimeoutReason() so the event/marker/notification reason differs: 'auditor-pane-died' vs 'auditor-timeout'. (3) The phase-field corruption at the old `const reason = \`${phase}-timeout\`` site (which was then passed AS phase into the inner runVerifiedDispatch call) is fixed: reason is now built by a small planTimeoutReason(phase, cause) helper and `phase` stays a real 'planner'|'auditor' everywhere -- the inner sentinel dispatch's own dispatch-failed event/marker now correctly carries phase:'planner' (or 'auditor'), not the synthesized string. runPostAuditAction's planner-failed handling was extracted to a new handlePlannerFailed(reason, notifyFn) helper (biome noExcessiveLinesPerFunction) that appends the reason to the notify string when present. All PlanPhaseResult 'planner-failed' consumers (test/plan-runner-no-prd.test.ts, test/integration/plan-runner-no-prd.test.ts, test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-replan.test.ts, test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts) construct/match the kind without a reason field and stay valid since `reason` is optional. Note for future stories: this story's diff was found already fully implemented but uncommitted at story start (git status showed modified plan-runner.ts + untracked test file, no prior commit) -- likely a prior worker invocation that completed the edit but was interrupted before commit/push; this run verified all 8 acceptance-criteria oracles (including the 3 targeted -t greps, the 2 sibling suites, typecheck, full bun test, and the full bun run check:all spine) pass green before committing, per Verification Before Done, rather than trusting the pre-existing diff on sight. No further plan-phase record-integrity gaps identified; CAM-479's epic scope (US-001 events.ts cause field, US-002 early-death detector, US-003 implementer/reviewer wiring, US-004 plan-phase honesty) is now complete per the PRD notes trail.
